customer: Caller, a small-business owner selling his convertible in Corlan, was irritated that nobody had told him what happens to his plates and worried he'd lose them when the car goes.
agent: Customer asked what to do with his license plates when selling his convertible. Explained per 'What to do with your license plates' that he should take the plates off before handing over the car and keep them. Let him know that what happens with them afterward is up to his state's motor vehicle agency, and that plates can usually be transferred to his next car. Customer seemed calmer once he understood he keeps the plates.
